inputs.original_text: Israel’s parliament began debating a Bill today that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. It was introduced by National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir’s religious party, and its passage would be a victory for the far-right minister. Opponents call the legislation racist and draconian and say it is unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants.
